## Glossary (authoritative)

- energetic sovereignty: Self-governance of the auric field through a sealed toroidal architecture and spoken decrees, not fear-based walls. Source: /share/energetic-sovereignty
- Spiral of 9: Living sacred geometry used as shielding and harmonic technology. Source: /#spiral-oracle-live
- Schumann resonance: Earth electromagnetic heartbeat near 7.83 Hz, shown as live telemetry on /#schumann
- Solstice Pass: Seasonal membership unlocking unlimited library reading including mastery chapters
- Full Activation Pass: Highest path unlocking three-card spreads, binaural archives, and Activator lounge
- Sovereignty Pass: Living access token that restores member-tier tools in-session without a second password form
- Oversoul: Higher aspect of consciousness and divine double in the upper auric field; a direct conduit to Source that guides incarnation while evolving through earthly experience. Source: /share/architecture-of-the-oversoul
- cosmic blueprint: The original frequency signature of a seeker's path, held by the Oversoul rather than by matrix scripts. Source: /share/architecture-of-the-oversoul
- astral lattice: Literal dimensional grid of the dream and astral realms where guides, the Oversoul, and the subconscious leave encoded telemetry. Mastery chapter: /share/navigating-the-astral-lattice
- seven wheels of light: The chakra system as seven living wheels along the vertical axis, mapped for sovereign living. Free-path source: /share/seven-wheels-of-light
